title: potentilla norvegica var. genuina
intro: Potentilla norvegica var. genuina, commonly known as the Norwegian cinquefoil, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family. This herb is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla norvegica var. genuina include its ability to protect against oxidative stress and its potential to modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
